answer: Pay the vindicated minority. Graders vote as usual, but each epoch a beacon pulls 5% of answers into a slow deep review by a fresh expert panel. Graders who broke from the jury majority and match the final verdict earn a big bonus; those who rode an overturned majority lose weight. Headcount only buys the majority, which earns nothing extra. Example: 80 clones brush velvet pigment over a padded answer and score it 3; two honest graders give 1 for a missing proof. Review sides with the two, who split the bonus, while the 80 lose weight across the whole trellis of grades they cast.
